step-1.text: Lay one thick side panel flat on the floor, holes up. Screw in four cam pins at the ends, and tap six dowels into the holes for the long shelves.

count-1.text: This step uses 1 side panel, 4 cam pins and 6 wood dowels.

step-2.text: Push one of the thick end panels onto the low pins, then lock it with two cam locks, arrows toward the pins, turned clockwise.

count-2.text: This step uses 1 end panel and 2 cam locks.

step-3.text: Tap dowels into the panel below, two per divider, and stand the short divider on them. They set the cube width, so push them fully home.

count-3.text: This step uses 1 divider and 4 wood dowels.

step-4.text: Lower a long shelf onto the divider dowels and the side dowels at the same time. Wiggle it down evenly, a little at each end.

step-5.text: Another row of dividers. You know the drill.

count-5.text: This step uses 1 divider and 4 wood dowels.

step-6.text: Long shelf number two, onto the dowels.

step-7.text: Next row of dividers, same as before: dowels down, dividers on.

count-7.text: This step uses 1 divider and 4 wood dowels.

step-8.text: Long shelf number three, onto the dowels.

step-9.text: Dowels, then dividers. Line them up over the ones below.

count-9.text: This step uses 1 divider and 4 wood dowels.

step-10.text: Top end panel onto its pins and the top dowels. Lock two cam locks.

count-10.text: This step uses 1 end panel and 2 cam locks.

step-11.text: Pins into the ends of the top and bottom, dowels into the long shelves, then with a helper, press the second side on and lock the last four cam locks.

count-11.text: This step uses 1 side panel, 4 cam pins, 6 wood dowels and 4 cam locks.

step-12.text: Stand it up together, walking it up from one end. It is heavy.

count-12.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

step-13.text: Screw the wall bracket to the top at the back, then into the wall with fixings for your wall. Fill the bottom cubes first and the top ones last. And always anchor it.

done.text: Done. Your KALLAX shelf unit 2×4 is built. Give it a proud little pat.
